problemStatement.plain: Is e + π transcendental? Famous open problem in number theory since 1882.
whyMatters: Open for 140+ years despite e and π individually transcendental
Would follow from Schanuel's conjecture (algebraic independence)
Connected to fundamental questions about algebraic independence of constants

proven: At least one of e+π, e·π is transcendental - PROVED via Vieta
If e·π algebraic → e+π transcendental - PROVED
If e+π algebraic → e·π transcendental - PROVED
π + e^π is transcendental - PROVED via Nesterenko
e^π is transcendental - PROVED via Nesterenko
Γ(1/4) is transcendental - PROVED via Nesterenko
Algebraic independence → e+π transcendental - PROVED conditionally
Algebraic independence → e·π transcendental - PROVED conditionally
Algebraic independence → e+π irrational - PROVED conditionally
open: e + π is transcendental (main conjecture - OPEN)
e + π is irrational (OPEN, even weaker statement unknown)
